evals.prompt: Reproduce the wrong VAT total in the shared module with a failing test.
evals.expectedBehavior: Writes the smallest failing commonMain JVM test — the failing run is the reproduction (Logic FULL).

evals.prompt: The avatar row clips in landscape on Android; reproduce it.
evals.expectedBehavior: Builds + diagnoses from the report/code without claiming to observe the render (UI ASSIST).

evals.prompt: The Gradle build fails resolving a dependency; reproduce the failure.
evals.expectedBehavior: Runs ./gradlew build and reads the build output as the reproduction (System).

evals.prompt: Confirm the previously-failing test now passes and the suite is green.
evals.expectedBehavior: Does not trigger — that is kmp-verify, not reproduce.

evals.prompt: I observed the running SwiftUI screen and the bug is gone — close it.
evals.expectedBehavior: Does not trigger — the agent cannot observe the device UI; this is an ASSIST handoff, not a reproduce/close.
